text: Being here, I am swept into the current of collective curiosity. The motion and energy of people passing by, some sitting in discussion behind the glass, others lost in thought or hurried along their way, evokes a sense of anticipation and reflection in me. The architectural transparency and organized gathering suggest a pursuit of knowledge, drawing my thoughts to the ways humans gather, learn, and progress. Here, I feel both apart and a part—simultaneously observer and participant in the unfolding human endeavor.
